# llms.txt — https://csoai-gspc.pages.dev (and councilof.ai)
# Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK 16939677)
# Independent measurement body for AI behaviour. We measure, sign, and re-attest.
# Everyone can check. Verified measurement credential — never certification. Not a notified body.

## Canonical surfaces
- [Home](https://councilof.ai): measurement body landing
- [councilof.ai](https://councilof.ai): flagship
- [GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): THE living board — 22 axes · 15 measured, 7 declared slots UNMEASURED
- [Signed scoreboard](https://councilof.ai/gspc-scoreboard)
- [Verify](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify): free, loginless, offline
- [GSPC MCP](https://csoai-gspc.pages.dev/api/mcp): streamable HTTP — tools `measure` + `verify`
- [mcp.json](https://csoai-gspc.pages.dev/mcp.json): one-line config for any harness (grok/claude/cursor/hermes/dsh)

## The living board (22 axes · 15 measured)
- GSPC API: `/api/gspc` → `totals.public_count` = "22 axis · 15 measured" (read it, never type a count).
- The 7 declared slots (reserve-attestation, regulatory-framework, distribution-integrity,
  custody-disclosure, three candidate indices) have NO run behind them — published UNMEASURED,
  never counted as a measurement. Jail is MEASURED with separation TIE.
- Per-axis signed measurements on HF: `huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-{gov,agi,prv,asi,mcp,oss,mach,care,xr,det,art5,swarm,affect,jail}`

## RWA / XRPL (measured on-chain, never tokenized, never a claim of ownership)
- Registry: `huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-board` → `rwa-registry.json` (14 instruments)
- An attestation is an independent verifiable opinion/measurement — never a token, never ownership.

## What we are not
- Not a certification body · Not a notified body · No money either direction with anything we rank
- No BFT-33 / 33-seat / Care Floor claims · SOVOS / SOVEREIGN / sov-* are internal, never public chrome

- [ProvBench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-prv)
- [GovBench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-gov)

- [PyPI csoai](https://pypi.org/project/csoai/)
- MCP: `io.github.CSOAI-ORG/gspc` → streamable HTTP `https://csoai-gspc.pages.dev/api/mcp`
- DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21991104

## Verify a card (anyone, offline, no account)
```bash
curl -sS https://csoai-gspc.pages.dev/api/measure-axis?axis=gov -o card.json
curl -sS -X POST https://csoai-gspc.pages.dev/api/verify -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @card.json
```
Three states, never two: VALID / INVALID(reason) / UNCHECKABLE.
